reels.title: HelixWorld: A Real-time Interactive Audio-Visual World Model

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper sits at the intersection of 'hardware_efficiency' and world modeling. The concept of synchronized audio-visual dynamics is perfect for 3b1b-style rhythmic animations, and real-time interactive models perform exceptionally well with our high-velocity audience.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if your AI assistant didn't just see the world, but actually listened to the physics of it in real-time?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A foley artist in a studio perfectly timing their sound effects to match a silent film as it plays on screen.
